name: Michał Pasierbski
title: Staff Software Engineer | Applied AI
summary: Staff Software Engineer and Engineering Lead with 15+ years building software, including at Google and AWS. I now lead engineering for Elaiia, a customer-facing Gen AI simulation platform, where I've shipped multi-agent workflows and the validation, tracing, evals, and cost controls they need in production. I also co-founded and shipped Notamify, an AI pre-flight briefing product.

highlights: Digital twin studies: Lead engineering for Elaiia, where customers run studies with digital AI twins as respondents, ask follow-up questions, and use the resulting reports to guide business decisions. Built its multi-agent simulation pipelines with LangGraph, FastAPI, and Next.js.
AI quality: Set production inference testing standards and built a multi-stage validation layer with deterministic schema and semantic checks plus an LLM-as-a-judge review for generated reports.
Observability & evals: Added end-to-end Langfuse tracing for output quality, latency, and cost. Built a framework for research teams to compare models and prompts.
Production performance: Improved orchestration and caching to manage latency and LLM inference costs.
Product telemetry: Built Grafana dashboards from production data for CEO/CPO roadmap decisions and automated alerts for inactive clients to support retention work.
experiences.tech: LangGraph, LangChain, Langfuse, Grafana, FastAPI, Python, TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL
